event.description:
Join Orbital Games and Comics in Revelfest, which is the celebration of this season's set! All participants gain double the VP at this event! Any player who participates in at least one ranked event during Revelfest will be eligible to win one foil Revelfest promo card, sent directly to the player alongside season rewards by Weebs of the Shore!

Tickets are $5, which include prizing, 1 non-energy drink, and 1 snack.
